_help: ideas are single date ideas. towns + templates make the rest: a template with 'sizes' is copied for every town of that size ({town} is replaced), a template with 'options' is copied once per option ({x} is replaced). minutes = drive from LE8 8AL, cost = rough total for two in pounds, vibes = inside / outside / chill.

ideas.name: Movie night in
ideas.about: Blankets, snacks and a film you've both never seen. Take turns vetoing until one sticks.

ideas.name: Board games and takeaway
ideas.about: Order in from your favourite place and play best of three. Loser washes up.

ideas.name: Home spa evening
ideas.about: Face masks, a bath, candles and a playlist. Phones in a drawer for the night.

ideas.name: Playlist swap
ideas.about: Each make a ten-song playlist that tells the other something about you. Listen with the lights low.

ideas.name: Garden stargazing
ideas.about: Blankets, hot chocolate and a star-map app. Best on a clear night with no moon.

ideas.name: Blanket fort and fairy lights
ideas.about: Build the biggest fort the living room allows, string up fairy lights and watch a film inside it.

ideas.name: Breakfast in bed
ideas.about: Pancakes, fruit and coffee on a tray. Take turns being the one who gets spoilt.

ideas.name: Write each other love letters
ideas.about: Twenty minutes each with pen and paper, then read them out loud. Keep them in a box.

ideas.name: Recreate your first date
ideas.about: Same food, same music, same outfits if you can. Compare what you each remember.

ideas.name: Bake a cake together
ideas.about: Pick the most over-the-top recipe you can find and decorate it for each other.

ideas.name: Homemade pizza night
ideas.about: Make the dough, then each build a pizza for the other with secret toppings.

ideas.name: Chocolate fondue
ideas.about: Melted chocolate, strawberries, marshmallows and a romcom.

ideas.name: Mocktail or cocktail bar at home
ideas.about: Take turns being bartender. Each invent a drink named after the other.

ideas.name: Cheese and wine tasting
ideas.about: Four cheeses, two drinks, score cards. Blindfold optional.

ideas.name: Jigsaw and jazz
ideas.about: A 1000-piece puzzle, a slow playlist and snacks within reach.

ideas.name: Lego build-off
ideas.about: Get a small set each, or build the same one together against a timer.

ideas.name: Co-op video game night
ideas.about: Pick a two-player game and play as a team. No rage-quitting.

ideas.name: Karaoke in the living room
ideas.about: YouTube karaoke on the telly, duets compulsory.

ideas.name: Kitchen slow dance
ideas.about: Cook together with music on, and every time a slow song comes on you have to stop and dance.

ideas.name: Indoor picnic
ideas.about: Blanket on the floor, picnic food, candles. A summer date in any weather.

ideas.name: Garden camp-out
ideas.about: Tent or sleeping bags in the garden, torches and toasted marshmallows.

ideas.name: Memory lane night
ideas.about: Scroll back through your photos together from the very first one. Print your favourites.

ideas.name: Couple's bucket list
ideas.about: Write 20 things you want to do together, then pick the first one and book it.

ideas.name: Plan your dream holiday
ideas.about: Unlimited budget pretend planning: flights, hotels, the lot. Then plan a real cheap version.

ideas.name: The 36 questions
ideas.about: Search for the '36 questions to fall in love' and take turns answering over a drink.

ideas.name: How well do you know me quiz
ideas.about: Write ten questions about yourself each. Loser makes breakfast.

ideas.name: Massage night
ideas.about: Massage oil, candles, calm music. Twenty minutes each, timed fairly.

ideas.name: Matching pyjamas night
ideas.about: Buy silly matching pyjamas, take the photos, then a film and popcorn.

ideas.name: Hot chocolate bar
ideas.about: Cream, marshmallows, sprinkles, flakes. Build each other the ultimate mug.

ideas.name: Candlelit dinner at home
ideas.about: Tablecloth, candles, three courses, dressed up like it's a restaurant.

ideas.name: Breakfast for dinner
ideas.about: Pancakes, bacon and waffles at 8pm, in pyjamas.

ideas.name: Blind taste test
ideas.about: Blindfold each other and guess crisps, chocolate and drinks. Keep score.

ideas.name: Make a scrapbook of us
ideas.about: Print photos, tickets and notes, and start a scrapbook you add to after every date.

ideas.name: Murder mystery for two
ideas.about: Buy a two-player murder mystery or detective case box and solve it together.

ideas.name: Two-person book club
ideas.about: Pick a short book to read this week, then discuss it over dinner.

ideas.name: Paint and sip
ideas.about: Two small canvases, follow a paint-along video with a drink, compare masterpieces.

ideas.name: Portrait swap
ideas.about: Draw each other in ten minutes. Frame the worst one.

ideas.name: Plant something together
ideas.about: Pick seeds or a little plant and pot it together. Name it.

ideas.name: Sunrise date
ideas.about: Set an early alarm, take a flask and watch the sun come up somewhere with a view.

ideas.name: Escape room in a box
ideas.about: Buy a boxed escape game and race the clock together.

ideas.name: Saddington Reservoir walk
ideas.about: Quiet loop around the reservoir and back along the canal. Bring a flask.

ideas.name: Canal walk to Kibworth for a drink
ideas.about: Wander the Grand Union towpath, then warm up in a Kibworth pub.

ideas.name: Foxton Locks walk and pub
ideas.about: Walk the staircase of ten locks, watch the boats, then food by the water.

ideas.name: Leicester Botanic Garden
ideas.about: Free gardens and glasshouses. Good for a slow afternoon and a coffee after.

ideas.name: A day at the races
ideas.about: Dress up, pick horses by their silliest names and put a pound on each. Check race days.

ideas.name: Show at Harborough Theatre
ideas.about: Small local theatre with plays, comedy and music. Check what's on.

ideas.name: Curry on the Golden Mile
ideas.about: Some of the best Indian food in the country, then sweets from a mithai shop to take home.

ideas.name: Show at the Curve
ideas.about: Musicals and plays at Leicester's big theatre. Check what's on first.

ideas.name: Gig at De Montfort Hall
ideas.about: Concerts and comedy in a proper old hall. Check the listings.

ideas.name: Leicester Museum and Art Gallery
ideas.about: Free entry: dinosaurs, Egyptian mummies and paintings, then a walk down New Walk.

ideas.name: King Richard III Visitor Centre
ideas.about: Where the king was found under a car park, then the cathedral next door.

ideas.name: Leicester Guildhall
ideas.about: A free medieval hall with ghost stories, next to the cathedral. Coffee in the lanes after.

ideas.name: Phoenix arthouse cinema
ideas.about: Independent cinema with a cafe bar. Pick a film neither of you would normally watch.

ideas.name: Abbey Park stroll
ideas.about: Riverside paths, the abbey ruins and the lake. Feed the ducks.

ideas.name: Victoria Park picnic
ideas.about: Big open park by the university with the war memorial arch. Bring a blanket.

ideas.name: Fosse Park shopping trip
ideas.about: Spend a set amount on each other, then food at the end.

ideas.name: National Space Centre
ideas.about: Rockets, the planetarium show and a lot of buttons to press.

ideas.name: Leicester Tigers match
ideas.about: Big crowd, loud atmosphere, food at the ground. Check the fixtures.

ideas.name: Leicester City match
ideas.about: Matchday atmosphere, scarves and a pie. Check fixtures and ticket availability.

ideas.name: Draycote Water walk
ideas.about: Flat five-mile path round the reservoir, with sailing boats and a cafe.

ideas.name: Kelmarsh Hall gardens
ideas.about: Pretty walled gardens and tea room. Open spring to autumn, so check dates.

ideas.name: Rockingham Castle
ideas.about: Castle on a hill with views over three counties. Seasonal opening.

ideas.name: Watermead Country Park
ideas.about: Lakes, a woolly mammoth statue and flat paths. Easy, relaxed walk.

ideas.name: Pitsford Water loop
ideas.about: Walk or cycle round the reservoir, then cake at the cafe.

ideas.name: Afternoon tea
ideas.about: Scones, sandwiches and too many cakes. Book a table.

ideas.name: Spa twilight session
ideas.about: Pool, sauna and a treatment each. Many hotels near Leicester do evening deals.

ideas.name: Kirby Hall ruins
ideas.about: A grand half-ruined Elizabethan house with peacocks. English Heritage, seasonal opening.

ideas.name: Boughton House
ideas.about: Called the English Versailles. Gardens and parkland; open in summer.

ideas.name: Fermyn Woods walk
ideas.about: Woodland trails, wildflower meadows and a cafe. Look out for butterflies in summer.

ideas.name: Fineshade Wood
ideas.about: Forest walks and red kites circling overhead.

ideas.name: Royal and Derngate show
ideas.about: Northampton's big theatre for plays, musicals and comedy.

ideas.name: 78 Derngate
ideas.about: A small house designed by Charles Rennie Mackintosh, with a nice cafe.

ideas.name: Delapre Abbey
ideas.about: Old abbey house with walled gardens and parkland walks.

ideas.name: Harlestone Firs
ideas.about: Pine woods with sandy paths, perfect for a long chatty walk.

ideas.name: Althorp House
ideas.about: Princess Diana's family home. Opens in summer only, so check dates.

ideas.name: Coventry Transport Museum
ideas.about: Free and huge: classic cars, bikes and land-speed record cars.

ideas.name: Herbert Art Gallery
ideas.about: Free gallery and museum next to the cathedral ruins.

ideas.name: Coventry Cathedral ruins
ideas.about: The bombed old cathedral beside the new one. Quiet and moving.

ideas.name: Belgrade Theatre
ideas.about: Plays, musicals and panto in Coventry. See what's on.

ideas.name: Coombe Abbey Park
ideas.about: Lake, woodland and a moated abbey hotel. Have a drink in the hotel bar after.

ideas.name: Brandon Marsh
ideas.about: Nature reserve with bird hides. Whisper and share binoculars.

ideas.name: Warwick Arts Centre
ideas.about: Cinema, theatre, comedy and music all in one place.

ideas.name: Bradgate Park walk
ideas.about: Deer, ruins and the climb up to Old John for the view. Pub in Newtown Linford after.

ideas.name: Beacon Hill Country Park
ideas.about: Climb to the top for one of the best views in Leicestershire.

ideas.name: Swithland Wood
ideas.about: Bluebells in spring and a flooded slate quarry. Very peaceful.

ideas.name: Outwoods walk
ideas.about: Ancient woodland in Charnwood Forest with easy trails.

ideas.name: Thornton Reservoir
ideas.about: Easy loop around the water with a cafe at the car park.

ideas.name: Sunset at Burrough Hill
ideas.about: Iron Age hill fort with huge views. Take a picnic and watch the sun go down.

ideas.name: Bosworth Battlefield
ideas.about: Heritage centre and walking trail where the Wars of the Roses ended.

ideas.name: Market Bosworth Country Park
ideas.about: Lake, arboretum and an easy walk into the pretty market square.

ideas.name: Battlefield Line steam railway
ideas.about: Steam train ride out to Bosworth and back. Check running days.

ideas.name: Great Central Railway steam train
ideas.about: Ride a steam train through the countryside. Check the running days.

ideas.name: Concordia Theatre
ideas.about: Local theatre with shows and comedy. See what's on.

ideas.name: Melton Mowbray food trip
ideas.about: Proper pork pies, Stilton and the market. Picnic on the way home.

ideas.name: Wicksteed Park
ideas.about: Lake, old-school rides and a lakeside walk. Entry is free, rides cost extra.

ideas.name: Rutland Water bike ride
ideas.about: Hire bikes and ride round the reservoir. The full loop is about 23 miles; the Hambleton loop is shorter.

ideas.name: Rutland Water picnic and walk
ideas.about: Walk out to Normanton Church on the water's edge and picnic by the shore.

ideas.name: Paddleboarding on Rutland Water
ideas.about: Hire boards or take a taster lesson. Summer months.

ideas.name: Rutland Belle cruise
ideas.about: A gentle boat cruise round the reservoir. Seasonal, check sailing times.

ideas.name: Rutland Water Nature Reserve
ideas.about: Bird hides, ospreys in summer and quiet lagoon paths.

ideas.name: Barnsdale Gardens
ideas.about: Dozens of little themed gardens and a tea room.

ideas.name: Twycross Zoo
ideas.about: Big on apes and monkeys. Book online for cheaper tickets.

ideas.name: Twinlakes Park
ideas.about: Rides and play areas that grown-ups can enjoy too. Check seasons.

ideas.name: Oakham Castle
ideas.about: A Norman hall hung with giant horseshoes from royal visitors. Free, then lunch on the square.

ideas.name: Lyveden New Bield
ideas.about: A mysterious unfinished Elizabethan garden lodge in the fields. National Trust.

ideas.name: Stoke Bruerne canal village
ideas.about: Locks, narrowboats, a canal museum and waterside pubs.

ideas.name: Salcey Forest treetop walk
ideas.about: A walkway up in the tree canopy, then woodland trails.

ideas.name: Silverstone Museum
ideas.about: The story of British motor racing, with simulators. Book ahead.

ideas.name: Ashby Castle
ideas.about: Climb the tower and explore the secret tunnel. English Heritage.

ideas.name: Warwick Castle
ideas.about: A full day: towers, shows and the river. Book online in advance for cheaper tickets.

ideas.name: Kenilworth Castle
ideas.about: Huge red sandstone ruins and an Elizabethan garden built to impress a queen.

ideas.name: Leamington Spa evening
ideas.about: Jephson Gardens, the Parade, then dinner somewhere nice.

ideas.name: Hatton Locks walk
ideas.about: Walk up the 21 locks known as the Stairway to Heaven, then the cafe at the top.

ideas.name: Stamford and Burghley House
ideas.about: Walk the deer park to Burghley, then the old stone streets of Stamford for dinner.

ideas.name: Conkers in the National Forest
ideas.about: Forest trails, treetop walkway and an indoor centre if it rains.

ideas.name: Hicks Lodge cycle
ideas.about: Hire bikes and ride the family trails round the lake and forest.

ideas.name: Belvoir Castle
ideas.about: Fairy-tale castle on a hill with gardens and big views. Seasonal opening.

ideas.name: Calke Abbey
ideas.about: The 'un-stately home', frozen in time, with deer park walks. National Trust.

ideas.name: Ice skating in Nottingham
ideas.about: Public skate sessions, then food in the Lace Market.

ideas.name: Wollaton Hall
ideas.about: The house from Batman, a deer park and lake. Park entry is free; parking costs.

ideas.name: Nottingham Castle
ideas.about: Castle grounds, galleries and the Robin Hood story, then Ye Olde Trip to Jerusalem pub below.

ideas.name: City of Caves
ideas.about: Underground tour of caves carved under the city. Good for holding hands in the dark.

ideas.name: Attenborough Nature Reserve
ideas.about: Lakes and wildlife with a floating-looking nature centre cafe.

ideas.name: Ferry Meadows
ideas.about: Lakes, meadows and a miniature railway. Hire a rowing boat in summer.

ideas.name: Peterborough Cathedral
ideas.about: Stunning painted wooden ceiling and Katherine of Aragon's tomb. Donations welcome.

ideas.name: Nene Valley Railway
ideas.about: Steam train along the river. Check running days.

ideas.name: Charlecote Park
ideas.about: Deer park by the river where Shakespeare supposedly poached deer. National Trust.

ideas.name: Snowdome skiing taster
ideas.about: Real snow indoors. Book a beginner lesson or a tobogganing session.

ideas.name: Stratford-upon-Avon and the RSC
ideas.about: Riverside walk, rowing boat, then a play at the RSC if you can get tickets.

templates.name: Cinema date in {town}
templates.about: Big screen, one large popcorn to share, and the back row if you can get it.

templates.name: Bowling night in {town}
templates.about: Two games. Loser buys the milkshakes.

templates.name: Escape room in {town}
templates.about: Sixty minutes to get out together. Book ahead.

templates.name: Comedy night in {town}
templates.about: Find a comedy club or open-mic night and sit far enough back not to get picked on.

templates.name: Live music in {town}
templates.about: Pick a band neither of you knows from the local listings and go anyway.

templates.name: Theatre trip in {town}
templates.about: Check what's on at the theatres and dress up a bit.

templates.name: Cocktail bar crawl in {town}
templates.about: Three bars, one drink each, and you take turns choosing. Mocktails count.

templates.name: Karaoke booth in {town}
templates.about: Book a private booth and sing your hearts out. A duet is compulsory.

templates.name: Museum date in {town}
templates.about: Each pick your favourite thing in the museum and explain why. Cake in the cafe after.

templates.name: Art gallery and coffee in {town}
templates.about: Find the painting you'd hang in your dream home together.

templates.name: Crazy golf in {town}
templates.about: Nine or eighteen holes with a drink in hand. Winner chooses dessert.

templates.name: Arcade night in {town}
templates.about: Spend a tenner each in tokens, pool your tickets and win something silly.

templates.name: Board game cafe in {town}
templates.about: Hundreds of games, staff who explain the rules, and cake.

templates.name: Sushi date in {town}
templates.about: Try one thing each that you've never had before.

templates.name: Street food in {town}
templates.about: Find a street-food market or food hall and share a little of everything.

templates.name: Late dessert date in {town}
templates.about: Waffles, sundaes or cookie dough. Skip dinner and go straight to pudding.

templates.name: Pottery painting in {town}
templates.about: Paint something for each other. You collect it a week later, so it's a second date too.

templates.name: Fancy dinner in {town}
templates.about: Find the most romantic restaurant in town, book a table and dress up properly.

templates.name: Dance class in {town}
templates.about: Salsa, swing or ballroom taster class. Nobody's watching, honestly.

templates.name: Cooking class in {town}
templates.about: Book a couples cooking class, then eat what you made.

templates.name: Bouldering in {town}
templates.about: Indoor climbing with shoe hire. Beginners welcome, no ropes needed.

templates.name: Trampoline park in {town}
templates.about: An hour of bouncing like kids. Grip socks required.

templates.name: Axe throwing in {town}
templates.about: Surprisingly fun, and an instructor shows you how. Book a slot.

templates.name: Laser tag in {town}
templates.about: Same team or rivals? Decide before you go in.

templates.name: Shopping and cocktails in {town}
templates.about: Pick one outfit for each other, then celebrate with a drink.

templates.name: Record shop and coffee in {town}
templates.about: Pick a record or CD for each other without looking at what the other chose.

templates.name: Big park picnic in {town}
templates.about: Find the city's biggest park, grab picnic food on the way and laze about.

templates.name: Night lights walk in {town}
templates.about: Walk the city centre after dark, take silly photos, and get hot drinks to go.

templates.name: Spa day in {town}
templates.about: Robes, pool, sauna, a treatment each. Find a couples package.

templates.name: Dinner date in {town}
templates.about: Stroll around, then pick a restaurant neither of you has tried.

templates.name: Coffee and cake in {town}
templates.about: Find the cosiest cafe in town and share two slices of cake.

templates.name: Pub dinner in {town}
templates.about: A proper pub meal by a fire if they've got one.

templates.name: Charity shop outfit challenge in {town}
templates.about: Ten pounds each to put together an outfit for the other, then wear them to dinner.

templates.name: Wander and ice cream in {town}
templates.about: No plan: just walk the streets and get an ice cream.

templates.name: Brunch date in {town}
templates.about: A lazy late brunch. Order something sweet and something savoury and share.

templates.name: Photo walk around {town}
templates.about: Take ten photos each of things that remind you of each other, then compare.

templates.name: Takeaway picnic in {town}
templates.about: Grab takeaway and eat it in the nicest park or green spot in town.

templates.name: Ten-pound gift challenge in {town}
templates.about: Split up for 30 minutes with ten pounds each and buy the other the best gift you can.

templates.name: New cuisine night in {town}
templates.about: Find a restaurant serving food neither of you has ever eaten.

templates.name: Pudding-only date in {town}
templates.about: Go out just for dessert. Two spoons, one plate.

templates.name: Sunday roast in {town}
templates.about: The full works with Yorkshire puddings, then a walk to work it off.

templates.name: Evening stroll and chips in {town}
templates.about: Chips from the chippy, eaten on a bench while the sun goes down.

templates.name: Book swap date in {town}
templates.about: Pick a book for each other from a bookshop or charity shop, then read the first chapter over coffee.

templates.name: Playlist drive to {town}
templates.about: Each make half a playlist, take the scenic route there, and get a drink when you arrive.

templates.name: Market morning in {town}
templates.about: Go on market day, buy picnic treats and something silly for each other.

templates.name: Country pub lunch in {town}
templates.about: A village pub lunch. Check the pub's opening hours before you go.

templates.name: Walk and pint in {town}
templates.about: Follow a footpath loop from the village, then a drink at the pub.

templates.name: Village picnic near {town}
templates.about: Pack a picnic and find a field or bench with a view.

templates.name: Sunset walk at {town}
templates.about: Time it for golden hour and take a flask of something warm.

templates.name: Sunday roast in {town}
templates.about: A slow village Sunday lunch, then a wander round the church and lanes.

templates.name: Cook {x} food together
templates.about: Pick a recipe, shop together, put on music from that country and eat by candlelight.

templates.name: Movie marathon: {x}
templates.about: Snacks, blankets and as many as you can manage before someone falls asleep.

templates.name: Learn to {x} together
templates.about: Follow a beginner video together. Points for effort, not results.

twists: Phones stay in the car or a drawer the whole time.
Dress code: wear something pink.
Each of you writes a little love note to hide in the other's pocket.
Take a selfie at every stop and make it your lock screen.
Hold hands everywhere you go.
Each pick a song for the drive and explain why.
Pay compliments only. No moaning allowed all date.
Ask each other: what's your favourite memory of us?
Dress up like it's a fancy first date.
The one who picked the last date gets spoilt this time.
Bring a disposable camera instead of using your phones.
Plan your next date before you get home.
Talk in your best posh accents for the first ten minutes.
Swap who chooses the food: you order for each other.
Finish with a slow dance in the kitchen when you get home.
Each of you gets one wildcard veto to use during the date.
Wear matching colours.
Buy each other a little something under a fiver.
Tell each other three things you love about the other.
Make a wish together at the end of the night.
Take a photo in exactly the same pose as one of your old ones.
Get a dessert to share, with two spoons.
Say yes to every reasonable suggestion the other makes.
Play twenty questions on the way there.
No talking about work all night.
Write down your favourite moment of the date and swap at bedtime.
Surprise kiss at every red light (passengers only!).
Bring a blanket, just in case.
Pretend it's your very first date and introduce yourselves.
Rate the date out of ten at the end and give one reason.
Make a playlist of 'our songs' for the drive.
End the night with hot chocolate in bed.
Whoever spots a heart shape first wins a kiss.
Trade jackets or jumpers for the evening.
Each choose one thing you've never tried before tonight.
Save the receipt and stick it in your scrapbook.
Leave a cute note on the mirror before you go.
Agree on one thing you'll do better for each other this week.
Take the long way home.
Hug for twenty seconds before you set off.
